items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She ended up getting I Marilyn, who ended up earning half a million dollars when we retired her.

ctx.x: So now, is there the Avakian stable?

There was. That’s the unfortunate story. The Anahid Avakian stable grew. She got – owners and other trainers and drivers helped her get good horses. She ended up getting I Marilyn, who ended up earning half a million dollars when we retired her. She was one of the really rising women in the business until she got in this ridiculous accident where a guy bumped into the back of her car on the Long Island Expressway, because he hadn’t realized everybody had stopped, dead stopped traffic. You know what it’s like? She…

yelled at the guy, got his name, etc. At the track, she said to one of the other people there, “I had this ridiculous accident. This stupid guy. I’ve got a pain in my neck, darn it.” This person reported it to the track doctor, who came over and said, “Anahid, I can’t let you on the track. The insurance won’t cover you if anything happens.” Anahid said, “I’m all right.” He said, “Nope. Gotta take you to the hospital and check you out in the emergency room.” There she was told, maybe she has whiplash. A few days…
